title: My 80 Series Restoration + LS Swap Project
ai_summary: 1996 80-series Land Cruiser LS-swapped after a head gasket failure, using a short-crank 2004 LQ4 6.0L machined with a 0.040-inch overbore, paired to a 4WD 4L80E transmission (fitted with a reluctor ring/VSS for Mark's adapter compatibility) and the retained stock transfer case. Engine was completed and installed by September 2025; front and rear driveshafts were being rebuilt for the added torque capacity.

complications.detail: Switching to a Mosely 80-series LS radiator with integrated electric fan for simplified packaging
Front driveshaft needs roughly 3/4-inch shortening and the rear shaft likely needs lengthening; both being rebuilt for higher torque capacity
Original engine wiring harness was unusable; sourced a BP Automotive harness and sent the ECU to LT1Swap for base programming and tach signal modification
Required a GM crank spacer (P/N 12563532) and extended flexplate bolts; engine biased about 1 inch toward the driver side with a 3.5-degree tilt
